brand-cursor[bot]

GitHub App

Automation bot that powers releases, Homebrew formula updates, version bumps, and npm publishing for the Cursor project.

Permissions

ScopeWhy
Contents (write)Create releases, push version bumps
Pull requests (write)Open formula and version update PRs
Checks (read)Verify CI before merge
Metadata (read)Repo discovery

Workflows it powers

WorkflowTriggerAction
releasetag push v*Build binaries, publish GitHub Release, update Homebrew tap, npm publish
pr-bodyPR openedAuto-fill PR description from template
stalescheduleMark stale issues, close if no activity
issue-responseissue commentAuto-reply to common questions
formula-sharelease publishedUpdate Homebrew formula SHA

Install

To add this bot to your own repo, create a GitHub App with the permissions above and set the secrets:

CURSOR_BOT_CLIENT_ID
CURSOR_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY

Then reference it in your workflows via actions/create-github-app-token@v3.
